children: Hindustan Unilever Limited (NSE:HINDUNILVR) posted 7% underlying volume growth in the September 2026 quarter, its best in 21 quarters. It approved an interim dividend of ₹19 per share, with November 12 as the ex-dividend and record date and payment due November 25, 2026.
: Hindustan Unilever posted 7% underlying volume growth in the September 2026 quarter, its best in 21 quarters. Advertising and promotion spending fell 9.3% year over year to ₹1,481 crore.
: Hindustan Unilever raised prices on Surf Excel, Rin and Wheel by up to 11%, or Rs 1–10 per pack, citing higher input costs. A 1-kg Surf Excel pack now costs Rs 245.
: Hindustan Unilever approved an interim dividend of ₹19 per share with its September-quarter results on October 28. November 12 is the ex-dividend and record date; payment is due November 25, 2026.
: Hindustan Unilever Limited (HINDUNILVR) raised the price of its 150-gm Moti Gulab soap by Rs 8, from Rs 74 to Rs 82.
